title: Senior Quality Team Member - Welding Consumables
department: Senior Quality Team Member - Welding Consumables
jobDescription: Location: Silvassa ( Dadra & Nagar Haveli ) Years of experience: 12 to 18 years Qualification : B.Tech/ MTech/ IIT Job profile requirements: Oversee quality for stick electrodes, FCW wire, TIG consumables, and SAW flux & wire. Maintain and manage ISO documentation and related quality systems. Handle customer complaints and coordinate corrective actions. Manage NABL documentation and lab processes in accordance with IS:17025 and NABL lab management requirements. Perform quality inspections and testing for welding consumables across SMAW, GMAW, GTAW, and SAW processes. Lead product approval activities, including trials, documentation, and customer sign-offs. Apply via the ADOR careers page.
